title: Support actual canonical owner metadata tenant on durable lineage reads without defaulting
summary: Supports canonical owner metadata.tenant_id on durable lineage reads without defaulting. In services/telemetry/lineage_read/service.py, adds explicit _owner_tenant envelope validation to honor both top-level tenant_id and metadata.tenant_id for Mapping and SimpleNamespace owner envelopes. Validates that if both top-level and metadata tenant IDs are present, they must be equal. Missing, foreign, conflicting, or invalid owner scopes fail closed with HTTP 404 (LINEAGE_TARGET_NOT_FOUND) without inferring tenant from request, environment, or event. Applies canonical owner scope validation to event hydration, binding hydration, and runtime binding graph node admission while preserving runtime/artifact/version qualification and actual paused binding status without ACTIVE fallback. Preserves immutable tenant-scoped PostgreSQL truth and the 5.0s bounded fetch deadline. Adds test_10 for explicit flat-only, metadata-only (dict and SimpleNamespace), matching, conflicting, foreign, missing, and invalid envelope regressions and test_11 for fresh-reader recovery of event trace and paused binding projection without re-ingest in services/telemetry/test_main_routes.py. Keeps net production diff strictly within <=20 lines budget (+17 net lines).
